blocks.text: Around 1960, Philippe René Doumic worked for Unifrance, where he helped promote French cinema internationally. Through his collection of 15,000 photographs, he captured both the “sacred monsters”—the legendary icons—and the rising stars of the film world in intimate moments. From Jean-Luc Godard to Alain Delon, his now-iconic images bear witness to the vitality of French cinema at that time. The Roger-Viollet agency now holds exclusive rights to distribute his entire collection.
